verdict.rationale: Vestd documents some automated actions, such as automatic Companies House updates and HRIS syncing, so asking whether automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of any user-defined automation with version history, change review or rollback. Admin review of option exercise requests is an approval step for a business transaction, not review of an automation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
